name: astro-launchpad
description: Launch editable Astro landing pages at startup speed.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @astro-launchpad/ai-kit build && pnpm --filter create-astro-launchpad build && pnpm --filter @astro-launchpad/template-base build && pnpm run build:presets
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc --project packages/ai-kit/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter create-astro-launchpad exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @astro-launchpad/template-base exec astro sync && pnpm --filter @astro-launchpad/template-base exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter create-astro-launchpad build && pnpm --filter create-astro-launchpad exec vitest run test/integration.test.ts
